description: This file defines a Searxng search tool class for integration with a larger system, including configuration interfaces, a class implementing search logic, and initialization code.

classes.name: Searxng_Tools
classes.description: A class implementing an interface for a search tool that wraps around the SearXNG search engine.

classes.name: SearxngSearch
classes.description: A class extending Tool that performs the actual search requests to the SearXNG API.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Searxng search tool with configuration parameters from nodeData.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs the search URL with query parameters for the API request.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Performs the search request to the SearXNG API and processes the response.
